svg.title: DM100 100 t Methalox 700 km Orbital Launch and First-Stage Reusable RTLS
svg.desc: 487-case validation of a 100-ton 7-engine Methalox launcher delivering 1,800 kg to a 700 km circular orbit with first-stage RTLS, 25.0–43.0 km unpowered grid-fin glide, 3->1 hoverslam, and 5 s upright standing.
svg.text: 700 km circular orbit (1,800 kg), unpowered grid-fin glide, 3→1 hoverslam & 5 s standing
